# Contributions

FrostLagoa Hub is a distribution repository maintained by Frost Lagoa.

It does not accept source-code contributions, pull requests, issues, or discussion threads. Product source code is maintained separately.

To download software, visit [Releases](https://github.com/FrostLagoa/hub/releases). For product assistance, use the support channel identified in that product's release notes or bundled documentation, if one is provided.

Redistribution permissions are described in the [license](../LICENSE).
